strings.zh: 这座灯塔结构很独特,{NEWLINE}走楼梯可以向上攀登,{CLEAR}但如果没有攀爬工具,{CLEAR}走楼梯是下不来的,{CLEAR}只能坐电梯下来。
strings.en: This lighthouse has an unusual{NEWLINE}design. You can climb up by the{CLEAR}stairs, but without climbing gear,{CLEAR}you can’t get down them. You{CLEAR}can only come down by elevator.

strings.zh: 浅葱灯塔上的电龙小明{NEWLINE}能比普通电龙发出更强的电力,{CLEAR}所以特别适合用来给灯塔照明。
strings.en: Amphy of the Olivine Lighthouse can{NEWLINE}put out more electricity than an{CLEAR}ordinary Ampharos, so it’s perfect{CLEAR}for lighting the Lighthouse.

strings.zh: 在塔顶小明休息的时候,{NEWLINE}就由发电机组提供这里的照明。{CLEAR}就算精灵们再强大,{CLEAR}也是需要休息的呀。
strings.en: When Amphy is resting at the top of the{NEWLINE}tower, the generators light this place.{SCROLL}No matter how strong Pokémon{NEWLINE}are, they need rest too.

strings.zh: 这些黑衣人突然闯进来{NEWLINE}就要把我们赶走,{CLEAR}真是太不讲理了。
strings.en: These people in black just{NEWLINE}burst in and tried to throw us{CLEAR}out. That’s so unreasonable.

strings.zh: 我认得这身衣服,他们是火箭队！{NEWLINE}呜呜呜,太可怕了……
strings.en: I know those clothes. They’re Team{NEWLINE}Rocket! *sob*... It’s so scary...

strings.zh: 我偷偷关闭了电梯的电源,{NEWLINE}这样就能稍微减慢一下{CLEAR}火箭队上塔的速度了吧。
strings.en: I secretly cut the power to{NEWLINE}the elevator. That should slow Team{CLEAR}Rocket down a little on their way up.

strings.zh: 飞碟磁怪,给我顶住！
strings.en: Magnezone, hold them off!

strings.zh: 飞碟磁怪『Maaa——ne！
strings.en: Magnezone: Maaa-ne!

strings.zh: 碍事的臭老头,给我去死！
strings.en: Out of my way, you{NEWLINE}stinking old geezer! Die!

strings.zh: 坦克臭鼬『Skuuu——ta！
strings.en: Skuntank: Skuuu-ta!

strings.zh: 冠军大人你快上塔去帮助蜜柑馆主吧,{NEWLINE}这些虾兵蟹将交给我们对付。
strings.en: Champion, hurry up the tower and help{NEWLINE}Jasmine! Leave these small fry to us.

strings.zh: 圈圈熊,让它尝尝你火焰拳的厉害！
strings.en: Ursaring, let it taste your Fire Punch!

strings.zh: 圈圈熊『Uuuu——sa！
strings.en: Ursaring: Uuuu-sa!

strings.zh: 不用怕它,盔甲鸟。使用保护！
strings.en: Don’t be scared of it,{NEWLINE}Skarmory. Use Protect!

strings.zh: 盔甲鸟『Skaaa——mo！
strings.en: Skarmory: Skaaa-mo!

strings.zh: 这里交给我们,{NEWLINE}冠军大人你快到上面去吧！
strings.en: Leave this to us,{NEWLINE}Champion. Hurry upstairs!

strings.zh: 这真是不忍心{NEWLINE}让你这雪白的皮肤受伤呢。{CLEAR}但是你自己找死就没办法了,{CLEAR}上啊,叉字蝠！
strings.en: I’d hate to hurt that snow-white skin{NEWLINE}of yours. But if you’re asking to die,{CLEAR}there’s nothing I can do. Go, Crobat!
strings.notes: Grunt addresses a female Gym trainer (雪白的皮肤).

strings.zh: 叉字蝠『Crooo——ba！
strings.en: Crobat: Crooo-ba!

strings.zh: 温柔待人这样的品德{NEWLINE}不是给火箭队准备的,{CLEAR}尽情地咬碎吧,大嘴娃！
strings.en: Kindness is a virtue that’s not meant{NEWLINE}for Team Rocket. Go wild and bite them{CLEAR}to pieces, Mawile!
strings.notes: | RV041: meaning: 尽情地咬碎 = bite to pieces freely; 'crush' lost bite and 尽情

strings.zh: 大嘴娃『Maaaa——wi！
strings.en: Mawile: Maaaa-wi!

strings.zh: 蜜柑小姐可能在楼上{NEWLINE}遭遇了火箭队的干部,{CLEAR}请冠军大人快上楼吧！
strings.en: Miss Jasmine may have run into a{NEWLINE}Team Rocket Executive upstairs.{CLEAR}Please hurry up there, Champion!

strings.zh: 我已经十多年没出手了,{NEWLINE}今天让你看看我的厉害！{CLEAR}冲撞它,波士可多拉！
strings.en: I haven’t fought in over ten{NEWLINE}years. Today I’ll show you what{CLEAR}I’ve got! Take it down, Aggron!

strings.zh: 波士可多拉『Aaaa——ro！
strings.en: Aggron: Aaaa-ro!

strings.zh: 天蝎王！给我迎头反击！
strings.en: Gliscor! Counterattack head-on!

strings.zh: 天蝎王『Gliii——co！
strings.en: Gliscor: Gliii-co!

strings.zh: 哈哈,冠军大人你也来啦！{NEWLINE}这些小喽啰不配做你的对手。{CLEAR}上面有火箭队的干部在,{CLEAR}你上去收拾那些家伙吧。
strings.en: Ha ha, you’re here too,{NEWLINE}Champion! These small fry aren’t{CLEAR}worthy opponents for you.{SCROLL}There’s a Team Rocket Executive{NEWLINE}up there. Go up and deal with them.

strings.zh: 为了保护蜜柑小姐和小明,{NEWLINE}楼梯现在暂不开放。{CLEAR}冠军大人可以先坐电梯上下灯塔。
strings.en: To protect Miss Jasmine and Amphy,{NEWLINE}the stairs are closed for now.{CLEAR}Champion, please use the elevator{CLEAR}to go up and down the Lighthouse.

strings.zh: 进出电梯的人由我来把关,{NEWLINE}严格落实一人一梯制度,{CLEAR}保证不放任何一个可疑人员上塔。
strings.en: I’m checking everyone who uses{NEWLINE}the elevator. One person per ride,{CLEAR}strictly enforced, so no suspicious{CLEAR}person gets up the tower.

strings.zh: 火箭队虽然撤退了,{NEWLINE}但保不齐还会有什么别的动作,{CLEAR}得保护好这里才行。
strings.en: Team Rocket has retreated, but{NEWLINE}who knows what else they might try.{CLEAR}We need to guard this place well.

strings.zh: 只要大家众志成城团结一心,{NEWLINE}火箭队根本不足为惧。
strings.en: As long as we all stand together as{NEWLINE}one, Team Rocket is nothing to fear.

strings.zh: 我是维护浅葱灯塔设备的工程师。{NEWLINE}最近我想给灯塔的电梯换几个新零件,{CLEAR}可是买零件的时候厂商都说卖完了,{CLEAR}看来维护计划只能暂时等等了。
strings.en: I’m the engineer who maintains the{NEWLINE}Olivine Lighthouse’s equipment.{SCROLL}I wanted to replace some parts{NEWLINE}in the Lighthouse elevator,{CLEAR}but the manufacturers all say{CLEAR}they’re sold out. Looks like the{CLEAR}maintenance will have to wait.

strings.zh: 哇,你拿着的那个{NEWLINE}不正是我需要的机械零件吗？{CLEAR}请问你能把它送给我吗？
strings.en: Whoa, isn’t that the machine{NEWLINE}part I need you’re holding?{CLEAR}Could you please give it to me?

strings.zh: 好吧……这种零件确实比较稀少,{NEWLINE}让你送给我是有点强人所难了。
strings.en: OK... Those parts really are{NEWLINE}pretty rare. It was a bit much{CLEAR}to ask you to give it to me.

strings.zh: 谢谢你愿意送给我,{NEWLINE}这下子电梯维护就可以开工了。{CLEAR}我这里有一套{CLEAR}以前做管道工程时穿的防水服,{CLEAR}是件特别定制的高级货,{CLEAR}作为回报,这件防水服就送你吧。
strings.en: Thank you for giving it to me! Now the{NEWLINE}elevator maintenance can get started.{SCROLL}I’ve got a Diving Suit I used to wear{NEWLINE}for pipe work. It’s custom-made, top{CLEAR}quality. Please take it in return.
